observations.conclusion: Shadow receiver resolves through contentSurfaceTransactor and its attached containerView to layer.
The outer content container receives setClipsToBounds(false).
Radius provider uses windowScene, keyWindow bounds, screen coordinateSpace and convertRect:toCoordinateSpace:. It cannot be replaced by an assumed constant solely from screenshot dimensions.

integration_decision: Separate the shadow-carrying outer surface from the clipping content surface in the future scoped repair. Exact clipping receivers and radius provider remain to be closed before claiming faithful recovery.
limitations: Static evidence only; no official target executed.
Full 0x7610404 return semantics and upstream 0x761087c remain unresolved; do not label returned scalars display corner radii yet.
Raw state and movementStyle cases are not assigned semantic enum names.
Animation timing and interruption behavior remain unresolved.
No app source change, device install or visual acceptance in this batch.
